title: Clarify that local and session storage are not the Web Storage APIs
body:
The terms "local storage" and "session storage" are defined in passing and are easily mistaken for the localStorage and sessionStorage APIs. This change adds a note where the terms are defined, explaining that they are categories of storage that differ in the lifetime of their data, and that the two APIs are storage endpoints within them.
